name_reason: Compliant with the global naming convention: data_fd2_ game-global prefix, battle_ core-table domain (matches every sibling summon-animation global in anisummn.c), summon_anim_variant_d domain descriptor (matches the sole accessor fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot), and color_rotation_counter reflects both the datatype (a counter) and the purpose (mod-10 color rotation). 'd' is a legitimate animation-variant domain label (variants a/b/d/e exist), not Ghidra address residue. Ghidra symbol and C symbol are byte-identical.
purpose: Mod-10 color rotation counter for the variant-D 3-active-slot summon animation; drives the per-color row-offset cycling.
logic_summary: Single uint8 of zero-bss runtime scratch used only by fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot. INIT (state_code 0) seeds it to 4 (the leftover slot-loop counter BL, store at 0x27333) before any read. On a frame-7 even tick (when terminate_flag is clear) it is incremented (0x273F8), read back (0x273FE) and reduced mod 10 via IDIV by 10 (0x2740A) with the wrapped value stored back (0x2740C); that 0..9 value is then copied into the active slot's color index (color_idx_array[i]) and the slot's frame counter is reset to 0. Never persisted; on-disk image is 0x00.
element_semantics: Scalar mod-10 counter, value range 0..9; selects which of the 10 per-color row offsets the next rotating slot uses, and is mirrored into that slot's color index.
notes: Source comment block (anisummn.c lines 170-186) was already accurate, precise, and conclusion-style (byte type, mod-10, INIT seeds to 4 with BL=4, zero-bss, all cited disasm addresses 0x27333/0x273F8/0x273FE/0x2740C verified against current disassembly, value stays 0..9 and is copied into the color index, single accessor) so it was left unchanged; no src Edit performed. Ghidra had the documentation in the deprecated PRE_COMMENT field with an empty PLATE_COMMENT, contrary to the data-plate convention (data plates belong in PLATE_COMMENT); moved a concise conclusion-form plate into PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline Java API (startTransaction/endTransaction) and cleared the stale PRE_COMMENT. Ghidra datatype confirmed byte len=1. is_const=false because the sole game-side accessor writes it (WRITE/READ_WRITE xrefs from fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot at 0x27333/0x273F8/0x2740C); it is mutable runtime state, correctly emitted as zero-bss (not const). No logic touched.
